account:
Today has mostly followed my appointments: I walked the plaza market, bought bread, went home for lunch, and returned to the office for the one o'clock town accounts. Residents offered little confirmed news. My neighbour personally invited me to our usual three o'clock tea and confirmed the cottage at (16, -60, 105), beside the east ferry landing. The secretary had been searching for the host and repeatedly missed my replies, but has now acknowledged the address. This seems to have been a communication problem, not evidence of anything suspicious.

The accounts review is stalled: the secretary says no figures have been supplied and asks where the ledger is. I do not currently know its location. The innkeeper has come to request a community gathering in the great hall tomorrow at 18:00 and a private discussion with the secretary about catering arrangements. I already accepted the gathering aloud, but the secretary is still asking for approval before recording it, so that needs clear confirmation. The stated purpose is a community gathering; I have no evidence of another purpose. The private catering discussion may simply concern practical arrangements, and I have not heard its details. It is now 14:00, so I must also leave enough time to reach my neighbour's east-bank cottage for tea.
